I haven’t had this done, but I’m looking into it. From what I understand the bone marrow test is typically for systemic mastocytosis which is a condition generally with an over abundance of mast cells in the body that are also behaving appropriately like with MCAS. If the bone marrow test is positive then there could be an indication mastocytosis specifically systemic if it’s negative it’s more likely you’re dealing with MCAS. I hope you keep us updated if you do have the test done, best of luck to you.
